dhelp.title: Tutorials
dhelp.seen.note: Been to {map}: normal runs skip lessons. Practise here any time.
dhelp.unseen.note: Not been to {map} yet: your first run there teaches this.
dhelp.desc.art_demo_03: Push a float over a pit: it won't fall, so you can walk across.
dhelp.desc.art_demo_04: Naihe Bridge holds one at a time. You plus a crate, and it gives way.
dhelp.desc.art_demo_08: Push a float stone over a pit: it hangs there, so walk across.
dhelp.desc.art_demo_09: Stand on a float stone and dig at a wall: you push off one cell.
dhelp.desc.art_demo_11: Gusts blow wood crates along: read the wind, let it push for you.
dhelp.desc.art_demo_12: Seesaws: drop something heavy on one end and the other end flies.
dhelp.assist.title: Delivery Assist
dhelp.assist.relaxed.desc: World and clock run at {n}. Par times stretch too, so tips stay fair.
dhelp.assist.think.desc: The clock stops in puzzle areas. No penalty, just this badge on the receipt.
dhelp.assist.heart.desc: Lose two runs in a row and the next one starts with an extra heart.
